recallio.title: Recallio
recallio.subtitle: Collaborative Flashcard & Spaced Repetition Ecosystem
recallio.desc: Versatile learning platform that allows users to master any subject through a Spaced Repetition System (SRS). It combines individual study with community collaboration: users can manage private decks or opt for public catalogs that evolve through admin-audited community suggestions.
recallio.challenge: The biggest challenge was database modeling and state management to separate individual progress from public content. It was necessary to design a system to 'subscribe' to public flashcards, tracking the user's own memory algorithm (SM-2) and allowing edits strictly in their private environment.
arch: Moderation Flows (NestJS): Robust API handling user roles and a review queue (drafts) ensuring public content quality.
Privacy Management (Prisma & PostgreSQL): Relational model separating public and personal content, tracking individual SM-2 progress.
Hybrid Frontend (Astro & React): Islands architecture with Astro for ultra-fast loading and React for complex interactivity.
Monorepo Infrastructure: Comprehensive management with pnpm workspaces and a standardized Docker environment.
